symptom: A tenant-authenticated lineage or explanation read returned HTTP 200 for a calculation_run_id owned by another tenant.
root_cause: The shared official calculation read service returned a synthetic available fallback whenever no tenant-scoped explanation row existed, without first proving that the run belonged to the authenticated tenant.
fix: Require a tenant-scoped calculation_runs ownership lookup before returning persisted or fallback explanation/lineage data; foreign and nonexistent run IDs return 404.
